waves.name: Writer, reader and the shared master file
waves.rationale: Two jobs, two programs and one dataset. The dataset is the only edge between the halves and it is a medium confidence contract, so the halves move together. No cycle, no god module and no computed call splits them any further.
waves.unblocks: One shared record layout that neither program owns, and a byte-level comparison harness for SPARQ.TEST.MASTER that any later job touching the file can reuse.
